mapper.insert: insert into round_seat (round_id, seat_id, status) values (#{round_id}, #{seat_id}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT s.seat_id, s.seat_x, s.seat_y, s.seat_name, s.floor, sg.seat_group_id, sg.group_name, sg.pos_x, sg.pos_y, sg.row_gap, sg.col_gap, sg.direction, sgr.on_img_url, sgr.sold_img_url, rs.round_id, rs.status, rs.reservation_id FROM round_seat rs JOIN seat s ON rs.seat_id = s.seat_id JOIN seat_group sg ON s.seat_group_id = sg.seat_group_id JOIN seat_grade sgr ON s.seat_grade_id = sgr.seat_grade_id WHERE rs.round_id = #{round_id}
